metaDescription: Order custom recycled dog tags for your team. Eco-friendly ID tags with your logo. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled dog tags offer a sustainable alternative for organizations that want to reduce environmental impact without sacrificing durability. Made from post-consumer recycled metals, these tags are perfect for safety managers issuing ID badges or marketing directors promoting eco-conscious branding. They accept standard engraving or debossing, ensuring your logo or text stays legible through heavy use. Choose recycled materials to align your promotional products with your company's green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom recycled dog tags with engraved logo, displayed on a keychain, showcasing eco-friendly metal finish.
